description: This file defines functions and types related to creating and managing test reporters in the Playwright testing framework. It includes functions to create reporters based on configuration, load reporters dynamically, and handle reporter errors.

classes.name: ErrorCollectingReporter
classes.description: A reporter that collects errors during test execution and outputs them via a screen object.

methods.name: createReporters
methods.description: Creates an array of reporter instances based on the provided configuration, mode, and optional descriptions.

methods.name: createReporterForTestServer
methods.description: Loads a reporter dynamically for a test server based on a filename and message sink.

methods.name: createErrorCollectingReporter
methods.description: Creates a reporter that collects errors and outputs them to a provided screen object.
